title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Develop the ability to summarize and report their thoughts and claims. (2) Learn how to write a report on a specialized subject. (3) Complete a manuscript.
advice: In this course, students learn the basic abilities related to the following: problem-finding information collection/analysis/organization problem-solving reporting by text distinguishing between plagiarism and citation For this purpose, students decide on themes in their specialized fields, collect information, organize it, learn how to write reports with cited references, and complete manuscripts. In addition, students will: 1. Gain an understanding of the latest technological trends in the field of Media Informatics. 2. Discover problems in the field of Media Informatics and learn how to collect, analyze, and organize information. 3. Learn how to express and present information, as well as to write reports that fit the field of Media Informatics.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students must review the content of "Basic Style for Study A/B" and improve the ability to read and write documents, as well as learn how to use the Library Center and the Internet to collect information.

Be able to collect, analyze, and organize information in the field of Media Informatics.
Be able to write reports that fit the field of Media Informatics.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
